instructions_to_main_agent: 2. THEME: Force 'dark' class on the html element. Do not support light mode. This is a bridge operation tool.
3. MAP: Use a dark-themed tile layer for OpenStreetMap (e.g., CartoDB Dark Matter). Standard OSM tiles are too bright.
4. LAYOUT: Create a full-screen map background. Float the 'Vessel List' as a collapsible sidebar on the left. Float 'Connection Settings' as a small widget top-right.
5. INTERACTION: Clicking a vessel in the list or map MUST open a 'Vessel Detail' panel sliding from the right.
6. PERFORMANCE: Use 'react-window' or virtualized lists if the vessel count exceeds 100.
7. VISUALS: Use the 'scifi_corners' style on the Vessel Detail panel to give it a technical HUD look.
8. DATA: Format all coordinates to 4 decimal places. Format speed to 1 decimal place with 'kn' suffix.
9. ANIMATION: Add a subtle 'pulse' animation to the vessel markers on the map.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
